prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a parking lot collision. The patient had 27 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1027; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of low back pain and stiffness. The reported mechanism is consistent with the symptoms described, and the presentation is a plausible account of a soft-tissue strain. Over the course of 27 visits, care consisted of manual therapy, targeted home exercise instruction, and graduated strengthening, which is a typical and expected course for this type of injury. Frequency of visits decreased steadily as range of motion and pain scores improved, and the patient was discharged to self-directed exercise once goals were met. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm a lumbar strain consistent with the collision. Review of the available history shows no prior injury to the lumbar region. Billing records reflect single, appropriate charges for each service rendered with no duplicated procedures. Prognosis is good with full recovery anticipated.
